last_scene.summary: After the crowd asked for something lighter, Arlequino performed the user-supplied 'Авантюрист'. The repeated opening 'Ветер шальной гонит туман... / Он, как и я, – авантюрист' immediately shifted the mood away from executions and war; younger listeners began swaying and clapping rather than shouting weapon slogans. The line 'Вольному – воля' drew approving calls from beastmen, while the reference to 'Блюмуедских раздолий' sounded like a distant place-name to most Eurazanians rather than something they pretended to know. 'Где-то, где-то любимая помнит и ждёт' produced teasing and softer reactions, especially from women and traveling fighters; Rena was not present and no one inferred her identity unless already told. The second verse 'Кто же авантюристов умом понимает / Душа её, сила её воспевает' pleased wanderers and mercenary types. The nonsense refrain 'Ой дага-дагадай...' became the easiest communal hook, with people joining without needing to understand anything. Overall response was cheerful and relieved after several grim songs. Tips 5s46c, expense 0; personal cash rises from 20g83s50c to 20g88s96c. Market activity continued normally in the background.
